After similar statements from V God in 2021, the foundation quickly reduced their sell-offs and accelerated ecosystem catalysts, while ETH's current pricing around 2100 hasn’t yet factored in this structural shift.

1️⃣ On-chain funding rates and position structure: Implied long/short imbalance
Currently, the ETH perpetual contract funding rates hover around 0.005%-0.01%, significantly lower than the 0.05%+ seen at the peak of the 2021 bull market, indicating a cold market leverage sentiment, with shorts not pulling out in large numbers. However, CME ETH futures open interest has surged to a three-month high, and institutional net outflows through the ETF channel have slowed—last week saw a net outflow of $216 million from ETFs, but compared to BTC ETF data for the same period, ETH's outflow rate has decreased by 30% from its peak. More critically, the number of staked addresses has surpassed 35 million ETH, reaching an all-time high, which locks up this portion of supply, reducing the circulating supply on exchanges. When funding rates are low, open interest rises, and spot supply contracts, it often signals increased price resilience against negative news.

2️⃣ Project events: Hidden signals of a strategic pivot for the foundation
Vitalik's statement is not just a personal belief but hints at the foundation shifting from "selling ETH to cover operating costs" to "using staking rewards to cover expenses." After similar comments from V God in 2021, the foundation promptly shifted its R&D focus, promoting EIP-1559 and the merge narrative, causing ETH to surge from $1800 to $4800. Currently, the foundation's research team is experiencing a wave of departures, but Vitalik has promised a "leaner foundation" with "less ETH sales," effectively reclassifying ETH from a "project expenditure token" to a "network reserve asset"—similar to the supply shock logic when the foundation locked up ETH before the DeFi Summer in 2020. If the foundation subsequently announces moving treasury ETH into staking, $2100 will become a historic discount.

3️⃣ Macro narrative: Divergence between ETF outflows and institutional allocation
Last week, ETH saw a net outflow of $216 million from ETFs, which seems bearish, but it's important to note that during the same period, BTC ETFs saw a net inflow of about $500 million, indicating a capital rotation rather than a flight from crypto. Even more noteworthy is that traditional banks like JPMorgan are beginning to hold ETH indirectly through ETFs, mirroring the logic when MicroStrategy bought BTC in 2021 and institutions began to view BTC as "digital gold." As ETH oscillates around $2100, the number of institutional custody addresses has increased by 8%, indicating that professional funds are capitalizing on retail panic to accumulate positions.

4️⃣ Risk points: Liquidation zone below $2100
We must acknowledge that there is about $4.2 billion of short liquidation nominal size piled up in the $2150-$2200 range; if it fails to break through in the short term, it could trigger a technical pullback to $2050. 当前ETH永续合约资金费率维持在0.005%-0.01%区间，远低于2021年牛市高峰的0.05%+，说明市场杠杆情绪偏冷，空头并未大规模撤退。但CME ETH期货持仓量却升至近三个月高点，且机构通过ETF通道的净流出放缓——过去一周ETF净流出2.16亿美元，但对比BTC ETF同期数据，ETH的流出率已从峰值回落30%。更关键的是，质押地址数突破3500万ETH，创历史新高，这部分筹码的锁定降低了交易所流通供给。当资金费率低、持仓量升、现货供给收缩时，往往预示价格对负面消息的抗性增强。

2️⃣ 项目事件：基金会战略转型的隐藏信号
Vitalik的声明不仅是个人信仰，更暗示基金会将从“抛售ETH支付运营”转向“通过质押收益覆盖成本”。2021年V神类似言论后，基金会随即调整研发重心，推动EIP-1559与合并叙事，引发ETH从1800美元飙升至4800美元。当前，基金会研究团队出现离职潮，但Vitalik承诺“更精简的基金会”与“更少ETH销售”，这实质上是将ETH从“项目开支代币”重新定义为“网络储备资产”——类似2020年DeFi Summer前基金会锁仓ETH的供给冲击逻辑。如果基金会后续宣布将国库ETH转入质押，2100美元将成为历史性折价。

3️⃣ 宏观叙事：ETF流出与机构配置的背离
过去一周ETH ETF净流出2.16亿美元，看似利空，但需注意：同期BTC ETF净流入约5亿美元，资金轮动而非逃离加密。更值得关注的是，传统银行如摩根大通开始通过ETF间接持有ETH，这与2021年MicroStrategy买入BTC后，机构将BTC视为“数字黄金”的定价逻辑类似。当ETH在2100美元附近震荡时，机构托管地址数却环比增长8%，说明专业资金正在利用散户恐慌积累筹码。

4️⃣ 风险点：2100美元下方的清算密集区
必须承认，ETH在2150-2200美元区间堆积约42亿美元空头清算名义规模，短期若无法突破，可能引发技术性回调至2050美元。但链上数据显示，交易所ETH余额降至2021年7月以来最低，而质押率持续攀升，这意味着卖压主要来自短期投机盘而非长期持有者。若价格跌破2050美元，质押解锁的延迟效应反而会加速底部形成。

一句话收尾：当Vitalik用身家押注、机构用托管地址投票、空头用资金费率筑底，2100美元的ETH正在复刻2021年合并前的定价偏差——历史不会简单重复，但押注供给收缩与叙事升级的剧本，此刻仍有胜率。

In the crypto space, no matter how much you earn, it’s just numbers on a screen. The real winners are those who can safely cash out! As a reputable C2C trader, today I'm sharing my hard-earned insights with newbies.

Choosing the right trader is step one; don't rush! If their name includes "Lightning Fast Withdrawals" or "Instant Payments", it looks convenient but is often a minefield. Focus on traders with stable monthly volumes and blue shield certification, then check for over 300 transactions in the last 30 days, a fulfillment rate of 99%+, and sufficient collateral. If the other party's funds aren't clean, you could still get caught up even if you play by the rules.

Keeping evidence is a must! C2C transaction orders, on-chain transfer records, and screenshots of chats with the trader—all information related to amounts and payments should be saved. This is your only lifeline if something goes wrong.

Pay attention to practical details: don’t use your salary card for receipts; prioritize city commercial banks or rural commercial banks. Deposit some cash in advance and make a few small transactions to leave a normal usage trail. After withdrawing, let it cool in your wallet for 72 hours, and split large sums into smaller transfers with intervals of over 24 hours.

Once the funds arrive, don't rush to transfer them out; let them sit for 72 hours to avoid bank alerts. Verify the payer's information, and if there are discrepancies, refund immediately. Also, never write anything in the transfer notes.

The process may seem cumbersome, but it can thoroughly mitigate the risk of freezing. Floating profits in crypto don’t count; having your money safely in your account is what truly matters. Advice for those with a small capital and new to the market

Most folks say when you buy a coin it dips, and when you sell it pumps, leading many to lose their funds this way.

Let me break this down for you

The pump trap makes the struggling trader buy, thinking the coin will rise more, but when they buy, the coin dips a few minutes later. This is normal because the mindset you had during your purchase mirrors that of thousands of traders who bought.

When they buy, the supply increases and demand decreases, causing the coin to drop.

So here's some advice, and I hope you follow it:

Don't buy when you see the coin pumping.

Don't put all your cash into one coin.

Make sure to research the coin before buying.

Don't sell when the price drops, no matter what happens, because market nature is supply and demand; just as it dipped today, it'll rise tomorrow.

Remember, you're in the market to profit, not to lose. Most see another coin rising and sell their first coin at a loss, jumping into the second one and selling that at a loss too, falling into the same trap. Don't sell at all.

Buy when the market is down, not up.

Don't sell without making a profit; learn patience,

Share your insights
#strugglingcoins

The pump trap makes the struggling trader buy, thinking the coin will rise more, but when they buy, the coin dips a few minutes later. This is normal because the mindset you had during your purchase mirrors that of thousands of traders who bought.

When they buy, the supply increases and demand decreases, causing the coin to drop.

So here's some advice, and I hope you follow it:

Don't buy when you see the coin pumping.

Don't put all your cash into one coin.

Make sure to research the coin before buying.

Don't sell when the price drops, no matter what happens, because market nature is supply and demand; just as it dipped today, it'll rise tomorrow.

Remember, you're in the market to profit, not to lose. Most see another coin rising and sell their first coin at a loss, jumping into the second one and selling that at a loss too, falling into the same trap. Don't sell at all.

Buy when the market is down, not up.

Don't sell without making a profit; learn patience,

Share your insights
